title: Ticking Create & Edit on Work orders also ticks View
custom_preconds:
1. Open Create Role and choose to start from scratch.
  2. In the Work orders card, View, Create & Edit and Delete are all unticked.
custom_steps:
1. Find the Work orders card.
  2. Tick the Create & Edit box.
  3. Look at View, Create & Edit and Delete.
custom_expected:
View ticks automatically.

Create & Edit is ticked.

Delete stays unticked.
evidence: UI: on blank Create Role form, ticking Work orders Create & Edit auto-ticks View (aria-checked View ON, C&E ON). screenshot cascade-final.
